comment: Source of docs/features.md. Render with `node scripts/feature-matrix.mjs`; verify with `--check`. A cell key may list several targets separated by commas. Targets a row does not list take the row's `default` cell. `tested` requires `evidence`: a repository path to an automated test that runs that feature on that target, plus the CI job that runs it. `device` requires `evidence`: a recorded run kept under `handoff/` (the generator checks the path's shape, and that the file is there when the folder exists).

android,android-tv.note: Android provider: `getMode().getRefreshRate()`, every mode's rate, and a `DisplayManager.DisplayListener` for changes; the host asks the window for the panel's highest mode at start-up, again after a mode switch, and again when the SurfaceView (re)creates its Surface, and pins the exact mode through `preferredDisplayModeId` at the current resolution. Unit tests: packages/platform/tests/display-service.test.ts and packages/renderer/tests/frame-loop.test.mjs (unit job). Measured on a phone emulator with the guest vsync at 120 Hz: 8.33 ms p50 frame deltas; at 60 Hz: 16.67 ms; an idle scene drew 0 frames. A multi-mode panel switch was not reproduced: the emulator exposes one mode. On a Pixel 7 Pro the start-up-only request left the app at 60 fps while the panel touch-boosted to 120 Hz; the surface and mode requests above are the fix, and the FPS meter now reports the display rate and the frame's own cost so the next device run distinguishes a rate request from a slow frame.
